symptom: Native retained photo upload returns HTTP500 INTERNAL_ERROR
cause: Installed Expo fetch normalizes File as Blob and overrides the explicitly supplied Content-Type with File.type (image/jpeg). Server food route previously registered only application/octet-stream. Fastify unsupported media type was wrapped as generic500.
fix: Food binary parser accepts bounded raw octet-stream, image/jpeg and image/png; existing declared-size/checksum/type/decode verification remains authoritative. Mobile owner separately changes File body to Uint8Array to preserve intended transport header.
